I've attached our marketplace checklist template to this thread for reference. Also looping in Jessica (ISV partner) and Atlas (deployment partner) as they will be part of technical evidence.

Available windows for a 30m sync next week: Mon/Tue 10–12 PT. Let me know what works and who should attend from Redwood.

Best,

Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU & onboarding for Redwood Inference - SKU mapping draft

Ben / Samir — attaching the SKU mapping spreadsheet (redwood-sku-mapping.xlsx). Summary below: 

- SKU: RWI-HOSTED-API-STD -> Meter ID: rwi.hosted.api.calls -> Metering unit: inference-requests (count)
- SKU: RWI-DEDICATED-BASE -> Meter ID: rwi.dedicated.instance.hours -> Metering unit: instance-hours (billing granularity: hourly)
- SKU: RWI-PRIVATE-VPC -> Meter ID: rwi.private.egress.gb -> Metering unit: GB-egress (only for private deployments that use Redwood-managed egress)

Notes/questions: 
- For Hosted API we track tokens + req-count; marketplace prefers a single meter id. I propose mapping to inference-requests with an optional SKU tag for token tiers.
- For Dedicated we need to confirm how the partner marketplace expects reserved capacity SKUs (monthly commit vs hourly). Suggest we offer both a monthly-listed SKU and a metered SKU for overage.

Attached: redwood-sku-mapping.xlsx (contains example rows and sample telemetry keys).

Olga Petrov
Catalog & Listings | Redwood Inference

Happy to join Tue 11/02 at 10:30 PT. I'll bring our SRE who manages the telemetry export.
